title: 7 Oils in One Organics Aloe Vera Hair Oil

details.description: Discover the nurturing embrace of Emami 7 Oils In One Organics Aloe Vera Hair Oil. Experience the goodness of aloe vera combined with seven potent oils, leaving your hair nourished and hydrated. This non-sticky formula revitalises hair from root to tip, promoting health and radiance. Gently massage into your scalp and hair for rejuvenation, and enjoy the benefits of well-nourished, non-sticky hair that exudes vitality. Elevate your hair care regimen with this natural solution for deeply nourished and hydrated locks.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Take a small quantity of oil and massage it well into the scalp and along the length of the hair.
2. Wash it out with shampoo.
3. Use post-bath for styling your hair and keeping it frizz-free.
details.storageInstructions: *Store in a cool, dry place away from direct heat & sunlight
